payload.name: pc-check-mode
payload.description: Pure-logic validator that accepts only the exact strings 'eco' or 'boost' (case-sensitive, no normalization) and returns an invalid-result object for any other value, including missing mode. Reads the raw candidate with inputs.get('mode') so absence is a valid invalid-result, never raises. Returns {accepted, mode} where mode is the original string when accepted and null otherwise. No imports, host calls, I/O or coercion; booleans and other JSON values are rejected, not coerced.
